gold: Trifascicular heart block (Bifascicular block with first-degree AV block progressing to complete heart block)

selector.rationale: Evidence of third-degree AV block with minimum heart rate of 36 beats/min and Mobitz type I second-degree AV block supports High-degree atrioventricular block

rejected.label: Pulmonary hypertension
rejected.why: Although present, it does not fully explain the patient's symptoms of syncope and exercise intolerance

rejected.label: Lev Cardiac Conduction Disease
rejected.why: While there is evidence of conduction disease, High-degree atrioventricular block is more specific and directly related to the patient's symptoms

rejected.label: Cardiac Amyloidosis
rejected.why: There is not enough evidence to support this diagnosis, and other explanations are more likely
